changelog.summary: Added OpenAI. Automated content moderation has sent flagged poll content to OpenAI since it launched on 3 March 2025, so this entry is a disclosure of existing processing rather than the advance notice described in Section 6.3. The objection right in Section 6.4 applies from the date this entry was added.
Annex 2 published with Vercel, Neon, Upstash, Amazon Web Services, Stripe, PostHog and Sentry.
